cards.body_en: First aid is immediate care given before professional help arrives.
Remove the person from water and check breathing immediately.

cards.title_en: First Aid for Cuts and Burns
cards.body_en: Clean wounds and cover burns with a clean cloth.
Do not induce vomiting; refer if symptoms are severe.

cards.title_en: First Aid for Unconsciousness and Seizures
cards.body_en: Place unconscious person in recovery position; protect airway during seizures.
